title: 32 — UGC Story Callout / Text Bubble Explainer
description: A casual iPhone overhead photo of a hand holding the product over a lifestyle surface (desk, counter, nightstand). Scattered across the frame: 5 Instagram-Story highlighted text bubbles in varied colors — topic + educational hook + why this product + personal result + brand endorsement. Zero ad polish. The story-native typography and hand-placed feel IS the format.
